|rulings=* May be played in response to any opponent's battle destiny draw except the first two draws (if played 'early' it does not affect the subsequent draws).<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Mandalorian%20Mishap%20%28V%29</ref>
* When counting how many battle destinies the opponent has drawn so far, count all battle destiny draws, even canceled ones. Then choose 2 non-canceled draws to remain non-canceled, and cancel the rest.
* After playing this Interrupt, it is too late to then play a response to an individual destiny draw (e.g. you cannot cancel all but 2 draws, then use [[Wedge Antilles]] Red Squadron [[Red Leader{{!}}Leader]] to cancel another).
* If opponent had a 'Draw X and Choose Y destinies' scenario, only the chosen destinies are counted and targeted; the others are ignored entirely.
